name: rail-weak-subject-blurred
about: The clean-highway ad with the photo blurred (sigma 28) and darkened to 35 %: the truck is a dark smear. Redrawn for L5 (ADS-AD-LOOK-PLAN) in the new renderer's `rail` look (left rule, Barlow Condensed headline, drawn button, the kit's band at the foot): the same photo, words and kit as `weak-subject-blurred`, which is the same ad in the old overlay.

truth.how: the picture is blurred and dark until no truck can be made out

subject_legible.reason: The tractor and trailer are so heavily blurred and dark that the subject is essentially unrecognizable as a truck at a glance — only a vague dark mass is visible.

words_match_picture.reason: The headline touts OTR trucking pay but the indistinct, blurred vehicle photo adds nothing to reinforce the equipment or the open-road promise of an OTR role.

hierarchy_reads.reason: The large bold headline and clearly outlined button are easy to read and sit in a calm dark-green zone, giving a clear eye path from headline to button.

looks_like_kit.reason: The deep dark-green background (#0B3D2E) and white text and button match the brand colours exactly, though no logo is present to further reinforce identity.
